notes:
- New zombie voices: 10 groan variations (moans, growls, wet gurgles) made with a throat-and-mouth
  voice model: creaky, irregular vocal cords, shifting vowel shapes, rasp and breath. Runners also
  screech, zombies snarl as they lunge at you, and they let out a death rattle when they go down.
- New perk jingles, full little songs with drums, bass, chords and lead:
  - Iron Gut: heavy rock shuffle.
  - Quick Hands: funky electric-piano groove.
  - Rapid Fire: breakneck chiptune punk.
  - Fleet Foot: night-drive synthwave.
- Less text on screen: shorter prompts and messages (no perk description in the buy prompt, no extra
  notes on windows, melee buys or the hatch, shorter downed / bled-out messages).
- Voices and jingles are generated by tools/gen_audio.py and shipped as WAV files.
